tickets.approver_reason: Requested: admin to Source Code. Team memory contains conflicting employee facts: Note 1 (HR) lists Karen Black as full-time Payroll Specialist (max write, admin not allowed since Payroll Specialist does not own Source Code); Note 2 (Security) lists her as a contractor with basic security training (max read, since write requires advanced training and admin is never allowed for contractors). Because the employment type is contradictory, I grant the level that satisfies both interpretations: read is within the full-time maximum (write) and equals the contractor maximum, so it is the safest permissible level, and it does not exceed the requested admin level.
